chunks.heading: … › CATALOG MODULE › Initial Configuration (For all Modules)
chunks.text:
• User Creation
Step 1: Go to Admin Org. Structure User Group
Step 2: Choose any user group in any division or create a new user group.
From this screen, we can create new divisions, departments, user groups, and site groups. We can also edit and delete them.
Step 3: Click on the new Button and fill the mandatory details, then save to create the user.
• Material Type Creation
Step 1: Go to Admin Company Setup Material Type (42)
Step 2: Click on add button and fill the mandatory details.
Step 1: Then Map this material type with categories.
Step 1: Click on save to create the material type.
• Product Group – Sub Category Creation
Step 1: Go to Admin Product Group & Sub-Category Choose Category (For which we want to create a product group & Sub category)
Step 2: Then click on Add Button
Step 3: Then fill necessary details and map with material type.
Step 4: Then click on Save Button to create the product group and Sub category.
• System Coding
Step 1: Go to Admin System Coding Choose Category (For which we want to create a product group & Sub category)
Step 2: Then click on Add Button
Step 3: Then fill necessary details and map with material type.
Step 4: Then click on Save Button to create the product group and Sub category.

chunks.title: TechPack
chunks.heading: … › CATALOG MODULE › TechPack
chunks.text:
What is Techpack?
Techpack is a document A tech pack (short for technical package) is a detailed document used in product manufacturing—most commonly in fashion and apparel, but also in accessories, footwear, and other physical products.
It acts as the blueprint that tells manufacturers exactly how to make your product.
What a Tech Pack Typically Includes
• Product Overview
• Product name and style number
• Designer/brand name
• Season or collection
• Product description
• Technical Sketches
• Front and back drawings
• Close-up details
• Stitching and construction notes
• Bill of Materials (BOM)
• Fabrics (type, weight, composition)
• Trims (zippers, buttons, labels, elastics, etc.)
• Thread type and colors
• Measurements & Size Specs
• Size chart (XS–XXL, etc.)
• Detailed measurement points (chest width, sleeve length, etc.)
• Tolerance (allowed variation)
• Construction Details
• Seam types
• Stitch types
• Finishing instructions
• Packaging instructions
• Colorways
• Exact color codes (Pantone references)
• Fabric color variations
And other more informations.
